ai_summary: Aditya Birla Sun Life AMC Ltd. reported a notable quarter-on-quarter decline in Q2 FY27 net profit and EPS, primarily due to a sharp reduction in "Other Income" from the previous quarter's elevated levels. Despite this, revenue from operations demonstrated healthy sequential and year-on-year growth, contributing to a positive year-on-year increase in H1 FY27 net profit. The unaudited results received a clean limited review report, indicating no material misstatements, though the observed volatility in "Other Income" warrants continued monitoring.
